Container.Name: undermynd
Container.Overview: Download and transcode orchestrator for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr. Acts as their qBittorrent and SABnzbd download client, downloads through TorBox (or hands off to qBittorrent / NZBGet), sends video through Tdarr, hands the finished file back for import, and cleans up. Includes built-in RSS auto-download and a public status page for your users. The public page is open, the admin page requires sign-in with a second factor, and the machine port is for your arrs only and must never be exposed outside your LAN. Settings are kept in /mnt/user/appdata/undermynd/config.

Config.Name: Public port
Config.Description: Public status page for your users. Safe to publish through your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Admin port
Config.Description: Admin interface. Publish only through your reverse proxy on its own hostname. Requires sign-in and a second factor.

Config.Name: Machine port (LAN only)
Config.Description: Download client API used by Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr (qBittorrent and SABnzbd compatible). Never expose this outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent database, settings and administrator account.

Config.Name: Data share
Config.Description: The one shared data folder. Must be the same path, on the same cache-only share, as in Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and Tdarr so moves are instant renames.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: 99 for nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid: 100 for users).
